records.name: CRP1
records.relation: involved in actin bundling and filopodia formation
records.quote: CRP1, which cross-links actin filaments to make actin bundles, is the only CRP family member expressed in the CNS with little known about its function in nerve cells.

records.name: CRP1
records.quote: Here, we report that CRP1 colocalizes with actin in the filopodia of growth cones in cultured rat hippocampal neurons.

records.name: CRP1
qualifiers: knockdown results in inhibition of filopodia formation
records.quote: Knockdown of CRP1 expression by short hairpin RNA interference results in inhibition of filopodia formation and dendritic growth in neurons.

records.name: CRP1
records.quote: Overexpression of CRP1 increases filopodia formation and neurite branching, which require its actin-bundling activity.

records.name: F-ascin
records.relation: actin-bundling protein involved in filopodia assembly
records.quote: F-ascin is an actin-bundling protein involved in filopodia assembly and cancer invasion and metastasis of multiple epithelial cancer types.

records.name: fascin
records.relation: actin-bundling protein involved in filopodia formation
records.quote: In this study, we investigated the role of fascin, a cytoskeleton actin-bundling protein involved in the formation of filopodia and cell migration, in prostate cancer progression.

records.name: Fascin
records.quote: Fascin is an actin-bundling protein that induces membrane protrusions and cell motility after the formation of lamellipodia or filopodia.

records.name: MAYP/PSTPIP2
records.relation: regulates F-actin bundling and enhances filopodia formation
records.quote: The PCH family member MAYP/PSTPIP2 directly regulates F-actin bundling and enhances filopodia formation and motility in macrophages

records.name: MAYP
records.quote: Overexpression of MAYP decreased CSF-1-induced membrane ruffling and increased filopodia formation, motility and CSF-1-mediated chemotaxis.

records.name: MAYP
qualifiers: reduced expression leads to opposite phenotype
records.quote: The opposite phenotype was observed with reduced expression of MAYP, indicating that MAYP is a negative regulator of CSF-1-induced membrane ruffling and positively regulates formation of filopodia and directional migration.

records.name: MAYP
records.quote: Overexpression of MAYP led to a reduction in total macrophage F-actin content but was associated with increased actin bundling. Consistent with this, purified MAYP bundled F-actin and regulated its turnover in vitro.

records.name: MAYP
records.quote: In addition, MAYP colocalized with cortical and filopodial F-actin in vivo.

records.name: fascin
records.quote: We report an unexpected direct association between fascin, an actin-bundling component of filopodia, microspikes and lamellipodial ribs, and protein kinase Calpha (PKCalpha), a regulator of focal adhesions.

records.name: Fascin
records.relation: actin-bundling protein involved in filopodia assembly
records.quote: Fascin is an actin-bundling protein involved in filopodia assembly and cancer invasion and metastasis of multiple epithelial cancer types.

records.name: IRSp53
records.relation: has actin-bundling activity and induces filopodia
records.quote: IRSp53, a multi-domain protein that can associate with the Rho-GTPases Rac and Cdc42, participates in these processes mainly through its amino-terminal IMD (IRSp53 and MIM domain). The isolated IMD has actin-bundling activity in vitro and is sufficient to induce filopodia in vivo.

records.name: Eps8
records.relation: mediates actin bundling and enhances filopodia
records.quote: Eps8 activates and synergizes with IRSp53 in mediating actin bundling in vitro, enhancing IRSp53-dependent membrane extensions in vivo.

records.name: IRSp53
records.quote: Consistently, Cdc42-induced filopodia are inhibited following individual removal of either IRSp53 or Eps8.

records.name: Eps8
records.quote: Consistently, Cdc42-induced filopodia are inhibited following individual removal of either IRSp53 or Eps8.

records.name: IRSp53-Eps8 complex
qualifiers: contributes to generation of actin bundles
records.quote: Collectively, these results support a model whereby the synergic bundling activity of the IRSp53-Eps8 complex, regulated by Cdc42, contributes to the generation of actin bundles, thus promoting filopodial protrusions.

records.name: vasodilator-stimulated phosphoprotein
records.relation: bundling activity required for filopodium formation
qualifiers: bundling activity required for filopodium formation
records.quote: The bundling activity of vasodilator-stimulated phosphoprotein is required for filopodium formation

records.name: vasodilator-stimulated phosphoprotein
qualifiers: key player for the formation of filopodia
records.quote: Filopodia are highly dynamic finger-like cell protrusions filled with parallel bundles of actin filaments. Previously we have shown that Diaphanous-related formin dDia2 is involved in the formation of filopodia. Another key player for the formation of filopodia across many species is vasodilator-stimulated phosphoprotein (VASP).

records.name: DdVASP
records.relation: F-actin bundling activity required for filopodia
qualifiers: mutant lacking F-actin bundling activity cannot rescue filopodia formation
records.quote: Only WT DdVASP, but not a mutant lacking the F-actin bundling activity, could rescue the ability of these cells to form WT-like filopodia.

records.name: DdVASP
records.relation: bundles nascent actin filaments in filopodia
qualifiers: complexed with dDia2 in filopodial tips
records.quote: Our data suggest that DdVASP is complexed with dDia2 in filopodial tips and support formin-mediated filament elongation by bundling nascent actin filaments.

records.name: IRSp53
records.relation: F-actin bundling domain involved in filopodium formation
qualifiers: N-terminal predicted helical stretch is an F-actin bundling domain
records.quote: Here, we show that the N-terminal predicted helical stretch of 250 amino acids of IRSp53 is an evolutionarily conserved F-actin bundling domain involved in filopodium formation.

records.name: IMD
qualifiers: formation of tightly packed parallel F-actin bundles
records.quote: The IMD alone, derived from either IRSp53 or MIM, induced filopodia in HeLa cells and the formation of tightly packed parallel F-actin bundles in vitro.

records.name: IRSp53
qualifiers: belongs to a novel actin bundling protein family
records.quote: These results suggest that IRSp53 and MIM belong to a novel actin bundling protein family.

records.name: fascin
qualifiers: localized to radially oriented actin bundles in filopodia
records.quote: Fascin localized to radially oriented actin bundles in lamellipodia (ribs) and filopodia.

records.name: fascin
records.relation: incorporated into actin bundles in filopodia
qualifiers: incorporated into actin bundles from the beginning of growth cone formation
records.quote: Using a fascin antibody and a GFP fascin construct, we found that fascin incorporated into actin bundles from the beginning of growth cone formation at the cut end of axons.

records.name: fascin
records.relation: retained in filopodial portion of bundles
qualifiers: retained in the distal, filopodial portion of bundles
records.quote: Later, during growth cone morphogenesis when actin ribs shortened, the proximal fascin-free zone of bundles increased, but fascin was retained in the distal, filopodial portion of bundles.

records.name: fascin
records.relation: required for actin bundles in filopodia
qualifiers: results in loss of all actin bundles from growth cones
records.quote: Treatment with tumor promoter 12-O-tetradecanoylphorbol-13-acetate (TPA), which phosphorylates fascin and decreases its affinity for actin, resulted in loss of all actin bundles from growth cones.

records.name: fascin
records.relation: important for filopodia structure and dynamics
qualifiers: important for linear structure and dynamics of filopodia
records.quote: Our findings suggest that fascin may be particularly important for the linear structure and dynamics of filopodia and for lamellipodial rib dynamics by regulating filament organization in bundles.
